_note: Samsung SSD 830 Series (S/N S0VVNEAC800147). Abandoned Windows 8.1-era laptop: installed Aug 2013, last hibernated Oct 2016. The local user profile (Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Pictures/Music/Videos) is EMPTY except for desktop.ini — everything lived in OneDrive. The real payload is Users/Steve/OneDrive (~32GB, all locally hydrated and verified readable): Documents 15.8GB, Pictures 8.5GB (2013-2014 Canon + Android camera roll incl. a 1GB .MOV and dozens of 200-500MB phone videos), Photos 6.9GB, Code, and trading spreadsheets (BTC.xls/csv/xlsx, NullOrders.xlsx). Favorites = 500 .url browser bookmarks. NTUSER.DAT = user registry hive (forensic/config artifact). Everything else on the drive is Windows/WinSxS/Program Files/AppData cache and volatile hiberfil/pagefile/swapfile — not harvest-worthy. Cross-drive dedup (DVRC-canonical + prior harvests) removes anything already captured. [da-89t]
